properties.name: USA
properties.source: Natural Earth 10m admin_0 countries; US buffered ~1.3km coastal, neighboring countries subtracted; islands < ~6 sq km dropped
properties.notes: Approximate US territorial polygon for coarse in/out membership. Coastal buffer tolerates coastline simplification but is trimmed against neighboring countries so land-border cities on the foreign side are not included. Not for legal / fine-grained boundary decisions.
